investment_recommendation: Hold provisional. The strongest supported metric is the 15.1% revenue growth from fiscal 2025 to 2026 [C:revenue_growth], which is positive but does not alone confirm an undervaluation or excessive valuation when balanced against a high P/E of 38.4 and operating margin below that of the primary peer Microsoft. Uncertainties from supply chain constraints and capex decline limit confident Buy conviction; however, growth and profitability remain solid, suggesting retention rather than Sell.
Insight: Apple’s supply constraints and rising costs, driven by industry-wide imbalances in advanced semiconductors, memory, and storage components, are expected to intensify, posing a material operational headwind beyond reported revenue growth [10-K line 1230].
